{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    tokens = case['tokens']
    calls = case['calls']
    intervals = [(call['start'], call['end'], call['score'], call['call_id'], call['replacement_tokens']) for call in calls]
    intervals.sort(key=lambda x: x[1])
    n = len(intervals)
    dp = [0] * (n + 1)
    prev = [0] * (n + 1)
    keep = [False] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        cur = intervals[i-1]
        p = 0
        for j in range(i-1, -1, -1):
            if intervals[j][1] <= cur[0]:
                p = j+1
                break
        include = cur[2] + dp[p]
        exclude = dp[i-1]
        if include >= exclude:
            dp[i] = include
            keep[i] = True
            prev[i] = p
        else:
            dp[i] = exclude
            keep[i] = False
            prev[i] = i-1
    selected = []
    i = n
    while i > 0:
        if keep[i]:
            selected.append(intervals[i-1])
            i = prev[i]
        else:
            i -= 1
    selected.sort(key=lambda x: x[0])
    result_tokens = []
    curr = 0
    for s, e, score, call_id, repl in selected:
        result_tokens.extend(tokens[curr:s])
        result_tokens.extend(repl)
        curr = e
    result_tokens.extend(tokens[curr:])
    return {'selected_call_ids': [call_id for _, _, _, call_id, _ in selected], 'tokens': result_tokens}"
}
